payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate CR-112 now has two Rust projections using the temporary spawned-task bridge: crate.outbound-sync-enqueue for async job enqueue and crate.inventory-reconciliation for async full-stream replay plus InventoryItem upsert. This strengthens the case that Frick should provide deterministic/observable async side-effect projection support instead of making each app hand-roll spawned tasks.
